# KOTA — Korea Festa

> Location-based Korean local festival travel packs for foreign travelers. 407 ongoing/upcoming festivals across Korea with dates, venues, directions and nearby attractions, in Korean, English, Japanese and Thai.

## What this site offers
- Festival list with region filter: https://yuneunmi814-cmyk.github.io/kota/festivals
- Festival detail (dates, venue, phone, directions, nearby spots within 3km): https://yuneunmi814-cmyk.github.io/kota/festivals/{id}
- Unified search (festival/region/attraction names): https://yuneunmi814-cmyk.github.io/kota/search?q=...
- UI and festival content localized in ko/en/ja/th (language switch in header)

## Data sources
- Korea Tourism Organization TourAPI (searchFestival2, areaBasedList2)
- Korea nationwide culture festival standard open data (data.go.kr)
- Manually curated local festivals not present in any public API (verified on site)
- Updated weekly via automated sync (2026-08-06)
